title: Over price with low Quality material.
body: Honestly, the HP OmniBook X Flip (14-kc0014AU) is way overpriced. For around 60k-70k THB, you get a cheap-feeling plastic body that flexes easily instead of aluminum. The keyboard area isn't flat, the webcam is mediocre, and power consumption is high. The OLED screen is great, but the lid is way too thick. Compared to a MacBook, HP really fell short on design and material quality with lower price.
product_name: HP OmniBook X 14" Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop - Deep Espresso Aluminum (AMD Ryzen Ai7 450 (Zen 5c)/32GB RAM/1TB SSD/Windows 11 Home)

title: Lack of support from HP
body: Avoid HP at any cost. Things go wrong however, providing the necessary support when things do fo wrong should be common business practice. Had laptop a month and it has been reset twice with the second attempt still not resolving this issue. It would be very hard to rate the laptop itself as I have not been able to use it sufficiently to know. HP has an active sales department but non-existent support department.

title: Issues with new purchase
body:
We purchased this new ~ $ 2000 HP Expresso Flip Laptop and had to bring it back as the start up downloads were not loading.

When we took it back to the Geek Squad, they experienced the same issue and had to open up new boxes. We finally got our laptop, however there were still issues and our son had to Navigate through HP websites to resolve.

We are dissappointed with this purchase.
